title: Pattern Core (P-Core)
summary: The Patterns window: a channel rack of your note tracks, drums as 1/16 steps and the bass and leads as a small piano roll, in a window of its own beside the main one.
steps: Open it from the Plugins menu (P-Core) or the piano roll's Tools > Patterns window. It is a window of its own: leave it open beside the others.

Each row is a track: M mutes, S solos, FX opens its effects, the knob is its volume. Click a step to add or remove a hit, drag to paint several. Bass and lead rows show their notes: a click there adds or removes a note on that 1/16 (the row's usual note), and Piano opens them in the main window for other notes.

BAR 1, BAR 2... show each bar of the pattern; the bars list sets its length (1, 2, 4 or 8 bars), Grid how many steps a bar shows, Swing pushes every second 1/16 later, Follow turns the bar with the playhead.
Velocity, under the rack, is the chosen row's: drag the bars up or down.

Main Groove, Variation, Fill...: each is a pattern on every track. + makes a new one, Duplicate Pattern copies this one, Clear Selected empties the chosen row. Play (or Space) plays the pattern alone, looped; Send to Arrange puts it on the timeline at the playhead's bar.

Templates, on the left: the P-Core styles (a groove written fresh on your tracks: kick, bass, hats... in the style's shapes and alignment) and the ones you saved with Save as Template. Preview plays one without changing the song; Load Template writes it (Ctrl+Z gives the notes back).
Right-click a row's name for P-Core: a shape for that row (KBBB, KBB_, gallop hats...) or another take of it.

examples.title: A hi-tech groove in two clicks
examples.text: Templates > Hi-tech, Preview to hear it on your sounds, Load Template. Then right-click BASS > P-Core shape > another one, or Another take, until it rolls.

examples.title: A fill for the end of the phrase
examples.text: Duplicate Pattern, rename it Fill (the pattern list > Rename), add snare steps in the last bar, Send to Arrange at bar 16.

examples.title: Your own groove as a template
examples.text: Build a pattern you like, Save as Template. It is under Templates > Mine in every song, and goes onto the tracks that play the same parts (kick, bass, hats...).

styles.why: Rolling KBBB, Eastern scales and runs.
Offbeat bass, pentatonic and few notes.
Broken rolls, tense scales, small sounds between the hats.
Triplet gallops, chromatic jumps, lasers and plucks.
Half-time feel, eerie and haunting scales, space.
Tight KBB_ bass with an Eastern colour.
